```{r new version with changes marked}
grid_P <- c(20, 160)           # CHANGED from c(20, 60, 160) -- participants per cell
grid_T <- c(20, 400)           # CHANGED from c(20, 60, 160) -- trials per participant

save_dir <- getwd()            
adapt_delta <- 0.9

message("Compiling Stan model once...")
sm <- rstan::stan_model(file = stan_model_path)


ez_forward <- function(alpha, nu, tau) {
  u <- exp(-alpha * nu)
  Pc <- 1 / (1 + u)
  nu_safe <- ifelse(abs(nu) < 1e-6, sign(nu) * 1e-6, nu)
  mu_rt <- tau + (alpha / (2 * nu_safe)) * ((1 - u) / (1 + u))
  sigma2_rt <- (alpha / (2 * nu_safe^3)) * ((1 - 2 * alpha * nu * u - u^2) / (1 + u)^2)
  sigma2_rt <- pmax(sigma2_rt, 1e-6)
  list(Pc = Pc, mu_rt = mu_rt, sigma2_rt = sigma2_rt)
}


simulate_one <- function(P, T, criterion = c("nu","alpha","tau")) {
  criterion <- match.arg(criterion)
  I <- P
  J <- rep(T, I)
  x <- runif(I, 0, 1)

  mu_alpha <- truncnorm::rtruncnorm(1, a = 0.1, b = 3.0, mean = 1.5, sd = 0.2)
  mu_nu    <- truncnorm::rtruncnorm(1, a = -3.0, b = 3.0, mean = 0.0, sd = 0.5)
  mu_tau   <- truncnorm::rtruncnorm(1, a = 0.05, b = Inf, mean = 0.3, sd = 0.06)

  sigma_alpha <- runif(1, 0.1, 0.4)
  sigma_nu    <- runif(1, 0.2, 0.4)
  sigma_tau   <- runif(1, 0.05, 0.25)

  delta <- runif(1, 0, 1)

  # x-effect only on nu 
  alpha <- truncnorm::rtruncnorm(I, a = 0.1, b = 3.0, mean = mu_alpha,          sd = sigma_alpha)
  nu    <- truncnorm::rtruncnorm(I, a = -3.0, b = 3.0, mean = mu_nu + delta*x,  sd = sigma_nu)
  tau   <- truncnorm::rtruncnorm(I, a = 0.05, b = Inf, mean = mu_tau,           sd = sigma_tau)

  fwd <- ez_forward(alpha, nu, tau)
  Pc <- fwd$Pc
  mu_rt <- fwd$mu_rt
  sigma2_rt <- fwd$sigma2_rt

  C   <- pmax(2L, rbinom(I, J, Pc))
  MRT <- rnorm(I, mu_rt, sqrt(sigma2_rt / C))
  VRT <- rnorm(I, sigma2_rt, sqrt(2 * sigma2_rt^2 / pmax(C - 1, 1)))

  simulation_data <- list(
    I = I,
    J = as.integer(J),
    C = as.integer(C),
    MRT = as.numeric(MRT),
    VRT = as.numeric(VRT),
    x = as.numeric(x)
  )

  true_vals <- list(
    mu_alpha = mu_alpha, mu_nu = mu_nu, mu_tau = mu_tau,
    sigma_alpha = sigma_alpha, sigma_nu = sigma_nu, sigma_tau = sigma_tau,
    delta = delta,
    criterion = criterion
  )

  list(simulation_data = simulation_data, true = true_vals)
}


fit_one <- function(simulation_data) {
  fit <- rstan::sampling(
    object   = sm,
    data     = simulation_data,
    chains   = chains,
    iter     = iter,
    warmup   = warmup,
    seed     = sample(1:1e6, 1),
    control  = list(adapt_delta = adapt_delta, max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
    refresh  = 0
  )
  post <- rstan::extract(fit)
  list(
    fit = fit,
    mu_alpha_hat = mean(post$mu_alpha),
    mu_nu_hat    = mean(post$mu_nu),
    mu_tau_hat   = mean(post$mu_tau),
    delta_hat    = mean(post$delta)
  )
}



run_grid <- function(which_criterion = c("nu","alpha","tau"), n_rep = n_rep) {
  which_criterion <- match.arg(which_criterion)

  total_steps <- length(grid_P) * length(grid_T) * n_rep
  pb <- utils::txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = total_steps, style = 3)
  step <- 0

  results <- vector("list", length = length(grid_P) * length(grid_T))
  idx <- 1

  for (P in grid_P) for (T in grid_T) {

    result_file <- file.path(
      save_dir, sprintf("partial_%s_P%d_T%d.rds", which_criterion, P, T)
    )

    if (file.exists(result_file)) {
      message("Skipping already computed: ", result_file)
      step <- step + n_rep
      utils::setTxtProgressBar(pb, step)
      results[[idx]] <- readRDS(result_file)
      idx <- idx + 1
      next
    }

    message(sprintf("Criterion=%s | P=%d, T=%d", which_criterion, P, T))
    cell_rows <- vector("list", n_rep)

    for (rep_ix in seq_len(n_rep)) {
      sim <- simulate_one(P, T, which_criterion)

      if (any(!is.finite(sim$simulation_data$MRT)) ||
          any(!is.finite(sim$simulation_data$VRT))) {
        step <- step + 1; utils::setTxtProgressBar(pb, step); next
      }

      fit <- tryCatch(fit_one(sim$simulation_data), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(fit)) {
        # only keep beta for the nu-criterion cells
        cell_rows[[rep_ix]] <- tibble::tibble(
          crit = which_criterion, P = P, T = T, rep = rep_ix,
          beta_true = if (which_criterion == "nu") sim$true$delta else NA_real_,
          mu_true   = sim$true[[paste0("mu_", which_criterion)]],
          beta_hat  = if (which_criterion == "nu") fit$delta_hat else NA_real_,
          mu_hat    = fit[[paste0("mu_", which_criterion, "_hat")]]
        )
      }

      step <- step + 1
      utils::setTxtProgressBar(pb, step)
    }

    cell_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(cell_rows)
    saveRDS(cell_df, result_file)
    results[[idx]] <- cell_df
    idx <- idx + 1
  }

  close(pb)
  dplyr::bind_rows(results)
}


make_band <- function(df, xvar, yvar, nbins = 16) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df %>% mutate(x_mid = !!sym(xvar), med = !!sym(yvar), lo = !!sym(yvar), hi = !!sym(yvar)))
  df %>%
    mutate(bin = cut(!!sym(xvar), breaks = nbins, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(P, T, bin, crit) %>%
    summarise(
      x_mid = mean(range(!!sym(xvar), na.rm = TRUE)),
      med   = median(!!sym(yvar), na.rm = TRUE),
      lo    = quantile(!!sym(yvar), 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      hi    = quantile(!!sym(yvar), 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

plot_recovery_grid <- function(df, xvar, yvar, title) {
  band <- make_band(df, xvar, yvar)
  ggplot(df, aes_string(x = xvar, y = yvar)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.6) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = band, aes(x = x_mid, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_line(data = band, aes(x = x_mid, y = med), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_grid(factor(P, levels = grid_P) ~ factor(T, levels = grid_T)) +
    labs(x = "True", y = "Posterior mean", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}


message("Running grid for criterion = nu")

message("Running grid for criterion = alpha")
df_alpha <- run_grid("alpha", n_rep = n_rep)

saveRDS(df_alpha, file.path(save_dir, "more_grid_results_alpha.rds"))
saveRDS(df_tau,   file.path(save_dir, "more_grid_results_tau.rds"))
```   

making recovery plots
```{r}
grid_P <- c(20, 160)          #c(20, 60, 160)
grid_T <- c(20, 400)          #c(20, 60, 160)

# make median/CI band
make_band2 <- function(df, xvar, yvar, nbins = 16) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || !(xvar %in% names(df)) || !(yvar %in% names(df))) {
    return(tibble(x_mid = numeric(0), med = numeric(0), lo = numeric(0), hi = numeric(0)))
  }
  df %>%
    mutate(bin = cut(.data[[xvar]], breaks = nbins, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(P, T, bin, .add = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(
      x_mid = mean(range(.data[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      med   = median(.data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE),
      lo    = quantile(.data[[yvar]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      hi    = quantile(.data[[yvar]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(med))
}


plot_param_grid <- function(df, true_col, hat_col, title,
                            point_col,
                            point_alpha = 0.70,
                            band_alpha  = 0.20,
                            median_col  = "black") {

  df_plot <- df %>% filter(
    !is.na(.data[[true_col]]), is.finite(.data[[true_col]]),
    !is.na(.data[[hat_col]]),  is.finite(.data[[hat_col]])
  )
  band <- make_band2(df_plot, true_col, hat_col)

  df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    mutate(P = factor(P, levels = grid_P),
           T = factor(T, levels = grid_T))
  band <- band %>%
    mutate(P = factor(P, levels = grid_P),
           T = factor(T, levels = grid_T))

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(.data[[true_col]], .data[[hat_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 1.1, na.rm = TRUE,
               color = point_col, alpha = point_alpha) +
    geom_ribbon(data = band, aes(x = x_mid, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = point_col, alpha = band_alpha) +
    # geom_line(data = band, aes(x = x_mid, y = med),
    #           inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4, color = median_col) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_grid(P ~ T, drop = FALSE,
               labeller = labeller(
                 P = function(x) paste0("I = ", x),
                 T = function(x) paste0("J = ", x)
               )) +
    labs(x = "True", y = "Posterior mean", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}
```
